games.name: Evolve: Rehydrated
games.desc:
A revival project for Evolve that is being actively updated and maintained. Credit to ClanAtlas and the original Evolve developers for originally developing this game!

This is a survival game where you build your own creature and earn DNA in an underwater ecosystem simulator!

🔬 Build your own animal in a sandbox editor with cells and abilities to play your role in the ecosystem.
🧬 Evolve your build to survive the oceans and fight other players to become the strongest life in the sea.
💀 Be careful, because other players can fight you too, and you will lose DNA on death!

The game is in INDEV! there will be glitches, resets, updates, and missing features.
--Inspired by Spore, Thrive, Rain World, as well as other ecosystem and/or life building games!--

Credit to: Rambuthan, Helfire_Arrow, and my staff team, couldn't have done this without all of you ❤️‍🩹

games.name: The Flappy Men
games.desc:
Game featuring ragdoll combat between deranged combatants.

Become a flappy guy and blast other flappy men with a huge arsenal of weapons! Nuke and destroy your way through the swamps of Florida, the Water Park, Thunder Bases, and much more! 

A graphics setting of at most 9 is recommended as to not ruin the art style with ambient occlusion.

protip, press "L" to change characters, "F" to join games in progress, and number keys for weapons. Also use "V" for first person and "CTRL" to change camera side.

games.name: ⚔️ [NEW MAP] Zulu Wars
games.desc:
Zulu Wars 📯 is a historical PvE game set during the Victorian Zulu War. Fight as a British defender or join the Zulu forces in intense wave-based battles inspired by real engagements such as Rorke's Drift. Choose from an arsenal of historical weapons including lever-action rifles, breech-loaders, revolvers, artillery, swords & more!

👉 Survive waves, earn coins, unlock new weapons and progress through regiments as you fight for victory.

🌿 PREMIUM BENEFITS: 2x coins

'HENRY WEST' UPDATE 17/04/27:
- Added Rorke's Drift Remastered map /w accessible roof
- Henry West custom voicelines for Colonel+
- Reworked pathfinding
- Zulu sharpshooters on later waves

📌 Take note
This game simply wishes to portray historical battles, and does not support racism of any kind. People in-game who engage in racism will be banned. Please be respectful!
